title.narrative: Human Security and Inclusive Digital Transformation: Knowledge Management for Resilient and Sustainable Development in Jalisco

description.narrative:
The programme aims to identify economic, social, environmental and cultural opportunities and strategies for pro-poor, inclusive digital transformation that promotes the holistic development of local communities beyond just providing access to connectivity and digital tools by strengthening the articulation of initiatives and programmes of the public and private sectors to promote human security and the development of digital, ethical, integral and inclusive ecosystems in the state of Jalisco.
The realization of this main objective will be carried out through three main outcomes:
− Cross-sectoral mapping of needs/vulnerabilities and capacities on the use of technology in Jalisco with the focus of Human Security. − Developing a programmatic and parametric framework for an ethical, inclusive, pro-poor, and human security-based digital transformation. − Developing a roadmap for implementing the action plan, toolkit, and model for achieving cross-sectoral, inclusive, and pro-poor digital transformation with the active participation of local communities to foster tangible improvements in people's daily lives.
These results respond to several interconnected challenges, linked to structural problems that the human security approach can address in a more comprehensive and multisectoral manner.
The programme will also develop useful and tangible methodologies for achieving digital transformation. The digital villages proposal will focus on the generation of digital community centers oriented to capacity building and participatory dialogue for knowledge management. On the other hand, the Readiness Assessment Methodology on Ethics of AI (with focus in HS) will directly contribute to generating spaces to improve personal and community security in the interaction with this type of digital tools. Both methodologies will include public policy recommendations for the State of Jalisco, the UN Agencies will be available in case the government would like to implement those suggestions.
